actions: Mapped campaigns file a room under its building, so two inns' kitchens keep their own memories and the GM is told the right one.
A place the GM names that the map lacks is added to the map beside the party; the GM may say where.
The map's additions are safer: an invented room never displaces a drawn one, and each refusal says why.
A room named through an invented building gets one place on the map, and a tap inside an added building no longer removes it.
An invented building without a trade word is drawn larger when a room the story names will not fit.
A room re-stated inside an invented building keeps its one place; a room named through a square finds its inn.
A pair the GM writes under a building it just invented is that building's room; a place put on a landmark draws no rooms.
Dice gain larger classic dots, optional Large Numbers, and a Teal Glass preset with consistent preset names.
